title: The Allowance the Dispensing Channel Earns on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Approval
content:
The channel through which a member of a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan has been getting their medicine may add an allowance to the approval run. The plan treats 3 or more fills of a channel as settled therapy in it.

1. Where the member's fills standing paid and dispensed by the plan's mail order pharmacy are 3 or more, the allowance added is the plan's mail order allowance of 30 days, because a ninety-day supply by post must be covered to the end of its own run.
2. Where the member's fills standing paid and dispensed by a long-term care pharmacy are 3 or more, the allowance added is the plan's long-term care allowance of 60 days.
3. Where neither count is reached, no allowance is added for the pharmacy channel.

| Fills standing paid dispensed by the plan's mail order pharmacy | Fills standing paid dispensed by a long-term care pharmacy | The allowance added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3 or more | any | 30 days |
| fewer than 3 | 3 or more | 60 days |
| fewer than 3 | fewer than 3 | nothing |

The mail order count is reached first: where the member has 3 or more mail order fills standing paid, the mail order allowance of 30 days is the one added, whatever the long-term care count may be.

## Worked on a hypothetical record

- 4 mail order fills standing paid and 5 long-term care fills standing paid: the allowance added is 30 days.
- 1 mail order fill standing paid and 3 long-term care fills standing paid: the allowance added is 60 days.
- 2 mail order fills standing paid and 2 long-term care fills standing paid: no allowance is added.
